title: McMoneagle tells Jesse that humans may be turning into the ETs

tellings.quote: he said that I think we might be turning into these etss or something they might be sort of prompting us to turn into some of them

plain: Humans may be slowly turning into the alien beings, or being nudged by them to become like them, according to Joe McMoneagle, a remote viewer, someone trained to try to see distant things with the mind. Michels says McMoneagle told him this on a phone call, putting it as "we might be turning into these ETs". If true, the visitors would be our own future, or a shape we are being led toward.
